User.title: User
User.description: Stores user profile information, authentication details (excluding sensitive credentials), and their assigned role within the CongreKids application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity (Firebase Auth UID).

displayName.description: The user's display name, typically from Google Sign-In.

email.description: The user's email address, typically from Google Sign-In.

photoURL.description: URL to the user's profile picture, typically from Google Sign-In.

role.description: The user's role in the application ('parent' or 'admin').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user's profile was first created.

Child.title: Child
Child.description: Represents a child associated with a specific parent user for childcare sign-ups in CongreKids.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Child entity.

parentId.description: Reference to the User entity who is the parent of this child. (Relationship: User 1:N Child)

Meeting.title: Meeting
Meeting.description: Defines the details for a specific weekly parent meeting where childcare sign-ups are managed.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Meeting entity.

title.description: The title or name of the meeting.

registrationDeadline.description: The timestamp by which parents must register their children for the meeting. Defaults to Thursday 23:59 before the meeting.

status.description: The current status of the meeting's registration period ('upcoming', 'closed', or 'past').

ageGroups.description: An array of age group definitions for childcare. Each string element is expected to be a JSON serialized object containing 'label' (string), 'minMonths' (number), and 'maxMonths' (number).

createdBy.description: Reference to the User entity (admin) who created this meeting. (Relationship: User 1:N Meeting)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the meeting record was created.

Registration.title: Registration
Registration.description: Records a parent's sign-up for a specific meeting, detailing which of their children will attend.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Registration entity, typically corresponding to the parent's User ID (uid).

meetingId.description: Reference to the Meeting entity this registration is for. (Relationship: Meeting 1:N Registration)

parentId.description: Reference to the User entity (parent) who made this registration. (Relationship: User 1:N Registration)

parentName.description: Denormalized display name of the parent who registered.

parentEmail.description: Denormalized email address of the parent who registered.

children.description: An array of children registered for this meeting. Each string element is expected to be a JSON serialized object containing 'childId' (string), 'name' (string), 'birthDate' (string, date-time), and 'ageGroupLabel' (string).

registeredAt.description: Timestamp when the registration was first created.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp when the registration was last updated.

cancelledChildren.description: Optional: An array of children who were initially registered but later cancelled. Each string element is expected to be a JSON serialized object containing 'childId' (string), 'name' (string), and 'cancelledAt' (string, date-time).
